# PDF Image Studio

> Private, 100% browser-based PDF and image tools. Fast, zero-upload processing with WebAssembly and HTML5 Canvas.

PDF Image Studio is a privacy-first web application that converts, compresses, organizes, edits, and optimizes PDF documents and image files entirely on the client side. No files are uploaded to foreign or remote servers.

## Tools & Features

- [PDF Page Organizer](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-organizer): Reorder, rotate, delete, duplicate, and extract PDF pages visually.
- [Merge PDF](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single file.
- [Split PDF](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/split-pdf): Extract page ranges or split PDFs by bookmarks.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file sizes with local canvas and image compression algorithms.
- [Image Compressor](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-compressor): Lossless and lossy photo compression with live quality preview.
- [Image Converter](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-converter): Convert between JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and SVG formats.
- [Image Resizer](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-resizer): Crop and adjust image dimensions with pixel precision.
- [Image Crop](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-crop): Interactive image cropping with standard aspect ratio presets.
- [PDF Watermark](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-watermark): Overlay custom text or image watermarks with opacity and angle controls.
- [PDF Page Numbers](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-page-numbers): Add page numbers with customizable placement and formatting.
- [PDF Metadata](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-metadata): View and edit PDF document properties and metadata tags.
- [PDF Flatten](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-flatten): Flatten interactive PDF form fields into static content.
- [Batch Processor](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/batch-processor): Execute batch transformations on multiple files concurrently.

## System Architecture
